intro: The PDF reader opens a document in your browser so you can read it without installing anything. PDFs are not uploaded: they are displayed on your device with PDFium, the rendering engine of Chromium browsers, and each page is drawn when you reach it, so long documents open smoothly too.

The toolbar lets you move between pages or type the number of the one you want, zoom in or out between 50 % and 400 %, and fit to width or view the whole page. The side panel shows thumbnails of every page and the document's bookmarks so you can jump straight to a chapter. Text can be selected and copied.

Search highlights every match and takes you from one to the next. If the PDF is a scan without text, the reader tells you so and you can make it searchable with OCR. You can also print it, download it or continue with another tool, such as annotating or editing, using the same file. If the document is protected, you are asked for the password to open it.

It also opens Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OpenDocument files, plain text, CSV and JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF or WEBP images. Those files are uploaded encrypted, converted to PDF on the server with the same engine as Convert to PDF and deleted when your plan's retention period ends: one hour without an account and 24 hours with one.

faq.q: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. PDFs are opened and read in your browser; only other formats go through the server to be converted.

faq.q: Can I open several documents at once?
faq.a: The reader shows one document at a time; use “Open another file” to switch to a different one.

faq.q: Can I write notes on it?
faq.a: To highlight, underline or add comments use Annotate PDF; to change text and images, Edit PDF.
